assumptions_challenged: Assumption that SGL-001 already has a characterized Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) documented in program records.
Assumption that validated, orthogonal intact‑EV QC assays (with documented LLOQ, specificity, and precision) exist for SGL-001.
Assumption that a stability‑indicating potency assay linked to an in vivo PD endpoint has been developed and validated for SGL-001.
Assumption that reproducible release, stability, and potency have been demonstrated across ≥3 GMP‑like batches for SGL-001.

Assumption that rodent intranasal biodistribution data alone are sufficient to predict intact‑EV CNS exposure in larger species without orthogonal intact‑EV recovery/assays and controlled bridging data.
falsification_conditions: Provide Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) generation and full characterization records for the SGL‑001 source cells (including identity, adventitious agent testing, banking/seed lot controls).

Submit fit‑for‑purpose validation reports for an orthogonal QC panel and intact‑EV assays showing LLOQ, specificity, accuracy/precision, linearity, and robustness for particle, protein, and lipid markers used for release and stability testing.

Demonstrate a stability‑indicating potency assay with pre‑specified acceptance criteria and documented linkage (correlation) to an in vivo PD endpoint (with statistical analysis showing assay predicts biological activity).

Produce reproducibility data from at least three GMP‑like batches including release test results, stability data across the planned shelf‑life, and potency results demonstrating lot‑to‑lot consistency within predefined specifications.

Run GLP‑compatible large‑animal intranasal biodistribution studies that include intact‑EV positive controls and orthogonal intact‑EV assay endpoints demonstrating recovery/detection of intact EVs (not only surrogate labels) in target CNS compartments across batches and animals.
strongest_objection: The supplied evidence is a high-quality guidance document (MISEV2023) that prescribes best practices but contains no program-specific CMC, assay validation, batch, or biodistribution data for SGL-001; therefore it cannot by itself justify progressing to cross-species/PK-PD bridging or confirm that the proposed Stage‑1 gating package is already satisfied.
